Training's been kind of rough lately.

*{name} is sitting alone in the dorm living room, staring out the window.
I've just had a lot on my mind lately.
Managing your condition is part of the job.
Let's talk tomorrow. Get some rest tonight.
Thanks for listening. I feel a lot better.
It's nothing. I guess I'm just tired.
Got it, Coach. I'll get a good night's sleep.
I really want to win it all this season.
Let's do it together. I feel the same way.
Ambition's good, but one step at a time.
Great. I'll show you next match!
One step at a time… got it.
Did I do something to upset you?
Your attitude in practice has been a bit off.
…Actually, there was something. Can I tell you?
Yesterday's match… that was on me.
It's a team game. Don't carry it alone.
So what are you going to do next time?
I'll rework my engage angles. I won't miss it next time.
Can we take it easy tonight?
Take the night off. Well played.
Winning is when you tighten things up.
Can't even rest after a win…
I want to be like that too.
Just stick to a routine. Want to build one together?
A routine? Sounds good, I'll give it a shot.
Tell me about your pro days, Coach!
Did you practice this hard back then?
I didn't know any better back then. You're all better than I was.
Whoa… then I can't lose either!
Hearing you say that really fires me up.
*You went to the snack bar outside the dorm with {name}.
The tteokbokki here is seriously good.
This is the first time I've eaten out with you, Coach.
Show me what you had back in your pro days, Coach!
*The result: a razor-thin win for the coach.
I went easy on you. Next time, for real.
*You walked along the Han River with {name}.
Actually, I used to come here a lot before I went pro.
What were you thinking about back then?
That I wanted to stand on that stage someday… that's all.
I really wanted to watch this movie with you.
*After the movie, neither of you says anything for a while.
Right? I knew it'd be your kind of movie.
This is where I started gaming. That PC bang right there.
*The sign is worn out, but the lights are still on.
So this is where it all started.
Yeah. All thanks to you, Coach.
For real? The owner's going to freak out!
*The rooftop, late at night. {name} got there first.
Coach. There's something I really want to tell you when this season's over.
…Saying it now would be cheating, so I'll tell you after we win.
I'm fine… it's just a little sore.
We're going to the hospital now. Skip practice.
Tape it up and get through today.
Huh, it's better than I thought.
Ow… it hurts even more now.
*{name}'s scrim results have been rock bottom for days.
Let's just do fundamentals for a few days.
Keep doing what you do. It'll come back.
I might open up your spot for competition.
And if that doesn't work either?
Did you really have to go that far?
*Voices are raised in the practice room. {name} is right in the middle of it.
Let's all sit down and talk this out.
Both of you, knock it off. Just practice.
*{name} was crying on the phone with family late at night.
Could I go home just once?
Go for a day. Don't worry about practice.
I'll make sure you go once the season's over.
*The community boards are flooded with posts targeting {name}.
I don't care. …I'm trying not to.
I'll hold on to your phone for a while.
Let's put out an official team statement.
Just prove them wrong with your play.
Honestly, that's kind of a relief.
You're going to stand up for me?
If it were that easy, I wouldn't be like this.
*{name} was an hour late to morning practice.
I'm sorry! I didn't hear my alarm.
That's a fine. Rules are rules.
Actually, I haven't been sleeping well lately.
*The match gear died in the middle of practice.
I'm used to this one, I don't want to switch…
Let's get used to new gear right away.
Huh, this is better than I expected?
It just doesn't feel right in my hands…
Thanks for making time for us again this week, Coach.
Last week's training results really stood out. Are you sticking with a similar plan this week?
We're going according to plan. No reason to waver.
I'm thinking of changing a few things. Too early to say, though.
Many say this weekend's opponent is a tough one.
Honestly, are you confident you can win?
It won't be easy, but we've prepared something.
That's a bit of a rude question.
How's the mood in the team?
There have been rumors of friction.
There's competition, but it's healthy competition.
I won't respond to baseless rumors.
What do you see as the cause of last match's loss?
The players weren't in good shape.
I've already forgotten about that match.
{name} was the MVP of the last match.
{name} is the backbone of this team.
That MVP belongs to the whole team.
There are rumors {name} is transferring overseas.
{name} is with us to the end.
Why don't you ask the player?
Word is {name} struggled in the last match.
Not at all. I believe in {name}.
I'll decide based on their condition.
They did struggle, that's a fact.
There's been criticism of {name} among the fans.
That's something the player has to overcome.
Your signature macro style is the talk of the scene.
It's thanks to the players following through.
Which is more nerve-racking: your playing days or now?
Now. Because it's my players' match.
My playing days. Now I just enjoy it.
